description: This file defines the DefaultCacheMonitor class, which implements the ICacheMonitor interface to monitor cache metrics related to streaming in Orleans. It tracks cache size, message statistics, memory usage, and pressure status, exposing these via observables.

classes.name: DefaultCacheMonitor
classes.description: Implements cache monitoring for Orleans streaming components, providing observables for cache metrics and pressure statuses.
